facts.fact: ch11 开场：Michele 夜里睡觉做的病梦（坠落、牛仔、漫画狼人、蓝调兄弟）
facts.anchor: At night in Rome Michele sleeps, and he dreams

facts.fact: 梦里含「与魔鬼打扑克输掉至爱」的意象，后文父亲再用扑克作喻
facts.anchor: He dreams of a man who plays poker with the devil and loses what is dearest to him in the world

facts.fact: 颜色与黑暗的形状先于图像凝聚成布景，把 Michele 放进一个故事里
facts.anchor: Red, yellow, and green spirals, blue squares and ochre diamonds, rays of darkness and black and white checkers marching over each other

facts.fact: 空教室变成「地方」：Michele 知道这不是寻常梦
facts.anchor: This isn’t a normal dream any more. This is a place

facts.fact: 他感觉脚下如赤足，低头看
facts.anchor: He can feel the floor under his feet, as if he’s barefoot. He looks down.

facts.fact: 低头见教室地面尽头起了小波浪
facts.anchor: There are little waves.

facts.fact: 海出现在教室前，教室如海滩般溶进水里
facts.anchor: An ocean has appeared in front of him

facts.fact: 数百米外一艘船抛锚，传来喧闹与哄笑
facts.anchor: A few hundred metres out, a ship lies at anchor

facts.fact: Michele 上一次如此清晰地听见这声音还是在小时候——父亲的声音
facts.anchor: he was little when he last heard it so clearly

facts.fact: Stefano 命名第三层：此处非 Flesh 非 Dream，是 Enchantment
facts.anchor: This isn’t Flesh,” says Stefano, “and this isn’t Dream. This is Enchantment

facts.fact: Stefano 确认这不是「像」梦幻岛而是彼得潘的岛本岛
facts.anchor: Not like; this is the Island of Peter Pan

facts.fact: 岛「有时」为实，是 Stefano 对真实性的限定回答
facts.anchor: Sometimes

facts.fact: 父子相处的时间极少，Stefano 确认
facts.anchor: Very little indeed

facts.fact: Stefano 列出三件待说之事：战争将至、角神已归 Flesh、关于祖父的事
facts.anchor: A war is coming, the Horned God is returned to Flesh, and there’s something about your grandfather that you ought to know sooner or later

facts.fact: Stefano 重申 ch07 那句赠言，并说「胸部是 Cavaterra 家的弱点」
facts.anchor: Your life is yours: I gave it to you, you’ll do what you want with it

facts.fact: Stefano 的人生课单条之一：先打败敌人再原谅
facts.anchor: Forgive your enemies, but only after you’ve beaten them

facts.fact: 岛主定了严格规矩：只有孩子、他拣选的少数生物与濒死者可踏岛
facts.anchor: The Lord of this Island has imposed strict rules

facts.fact: Stefano 点明：Michele 是被召唤者，这是一场启蒙
facts.anchor: You’ve been Called. This is your initiation

facts.fact: Stefano 自陈阿尔茨海默吞噬他的大脑
facts.anchor: Alzheimer’s devoured my brains

facts.fact: Stefano 说是情感的原始力量带肉身来到岛上
facts.anchor: It was the raw power of my emotions that let me travel here with my body

facts.fact: Stefano 宣布他停止抗争、正在死去
facts.anchor: I’ve stopped fighting, Michele. I’m dying

facts.fact: Stefano 说余生五六年不值与儿子半小时谈话
facts.anchor: Not even ten are worth half an hour chatting with you.

facts.fact: 叙述者声明退出，把半小时留给父子
facts.anchor: And we will leave them here alone, father and son

facts.fact: 时间到：海面变成完全静止的平面
facts.anchor: The ocean has become a completely motionless expanse.

facts.fact: Michele 问父亲死后去哪，Stefano 答从没死过
facts.anchor: I’ve never died before

facts.fact: 海上光点凝出人形，Stefano 催 Michele 出发
facts.anchor: “Go,” says Stefano.

facts.fact: 接引者是个红发、朋克短发、绿上衣牛仔裤的年轻女子
facts.anchor: She wears jeans, black gym shoes, and an extremely clingy green crop top

facts.fact: 女子自称 Eris（不和女神之名），说「我喜欢这个名字」
facts.anchor: You can call me Eris, anyway

facts.fact: Eris 把 Michele 从 Enchantment 推落入 Dream：地点是罗马地底废弃地铁站
facts.anchor: Under Rome

facts.fact: Eris 指出 Michele 已有的能力：广告牌对话、涂鸦灵感即灵体
facts.anchor: Never found inspiration in the graffiti on the walls? These are spirits, Michele.

facts.fact: Eris 报名城市灵体：家庭暴力、污染、速度、城市植被等
facts.anchor: The coward Domestic Violence, the mighty Pollution, the seductive Speed, the ambiguous Urban Vegetation

facts.fact: 万灵之上是罗马本身：母亲之城，是她召唤了 Michele
facts.anchor: above them and greater than them all, Rome, Mother City

facts.fact: Eris 以母乳为启蒙媒介
facts.anchor: Drink from me,” says Eris, “and you’ll understand

facts.fact: 原文相邻两句：The milk transforms him. / The milk awakens him.
facts.anchor: The milk awakens him.

facts.fact: 启蒙后 Michele 听见城市万物的模式与美
facts.anchor: A pigeon flying, a youth running, another playing music, another writing.

facts.fact: Michele 出隧道后身处大废车场
facts.anchor: He’s in a junkyard.

facts.fact: rats 叠成两米高的巨鼠 Rat
facts.anchor: The mass of rats grows, it gets as tall as Michele, and taller, it reaches two metres high.

facts.fact: 唯一幸存的老鼠爬上 Michele 身体咬向他喉咙，原文以 That is exactly what happens. 确认
facts.anchor: That is exactly what happens.

facts.fact: Michele 被鼠群分食眼球、鼻腔入脑，窒息而死
facts.anchor: He dies gasping.

facts.fact: 死后 Michele 看见街道与汽车中的生命
facts.anchor: Now that he’s dead Michele can see the life that’s in the streets and in the cars

facts.fact: 城市做梦，人类施工；人生活在活物的体内而不自知
facts.anchor: The city dreams improvements that humans carry out

facts.fact: 万物之灵向他行礼——他被认作 Mother City 之子
facts.anchor: They all salute him.

facts.fact: 不美处：司法宫是灰色，天使被钉在地上；无爱所建之塔楼同样灰
facts.anchor: The Palace of Justice is grey

facts.fact: 灯柱顶上的电动小灵体解释了 ch04 父亲凝视路灯杆
facts.anchor: That’s what Papa saw on the lamppost, thinks Michele.

facts.fact: 意面 square colosseum（Laurentina 区的方形斗兽场建筑之灵）欢迎他
facts.anchor: Welcome, Michele, it greets him.

facts.fact: 方形斗兽场之灵邀 Michele 「乘我而行」
facts.anchor: Travel me.

facts.fact: 登顶后灵要他跳；他跳入台伯河
facts.anchor: Jump, says Square Colosseum.

facts.fact: 水之女儿们误认作 Peter，彼此私语
facts.anchor: … no, the shaman …

facts.fact: 粗声的台伯河讲出故事：Wedge 与 PsyKlops 桥上欺侮尼日利亚男孩致其溺亡
facts.anchor: Gruff Tiber tells a story.

facts.fact: 台伯河的「女儿们」淹死了孩子——Flesh 的规则如此
facts.anchor: And my daughters killed the child, for such are the rules of Flesh.

facts.fact: 次年主显节，Lost Children 选中这两个孩子去传话给 Captain Hook
facts.anchor: When the next Epiphany came, the Lost Children chose them to spread their message

facts.fact: Wedge 是虎克克的鼻眼耳；Michele 将成城市的「声音」
facts.anchor: He is the nose, eyes, and ears of Hook.

facts.fact: Michele 在废车场尸旁醒来，三只老鼠衔来建筑材料
facts.anchor: He wakes in the junkyard, beside his corpse.

facts.fact: Eris 把碎砖塞进肠道：他们杀的是「作为人的你」，如今重生为萨满
facts.anchor: Now you are reborn a shaman

facts.fact: Eris 说 Michele 是罗马第一个知情者/觉者
facts.anchor: You are Rome’s first cognisant

facts.fact: Eris 给出三件法器：镜代眼、诞生中的建筑之石、城骨之钢
facts.anchor: enchanted mirrors in place of eyes, the stone of a building being born, and the steel that forms the structure of the City

facts.fact: 萨满不崇拜，只作中介
facts.anchor: You don’t worship, you mediate.

facts.fact: Eris 揭出：父亲的阿尔茨海默不自然，是虎克克所为
facts.anchor: Stefano’s Alzheimer’s wasn’t natural. It was his doing

facts.fact: 剧痛中 Michele 在 Flesh 里睁眼
facts.anchor: He opens his eyes in Flesh.
